s0001.literal: Emperor Yingzong, posthumous name Ruisheng Wenxiao, taboo name Shidebala, was Renzong's son by the primary consort.
s0001.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong, posthumous name Ruisheng Wenxiao, taboo name Shidebala, was Renzong's son by the primary consort.

s0002.literal: His mother was Empress Zhuangyi the Compassionate and Sacred of the Hongjira clan; he was born on jiazi day in the second month of the seventh year of Dade.
s0002.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zhuangyi the Compassionate and Sacred of the Hongjira clan; he was born on jiazi day in the second month of the seventh year of Dade.

s0003.literal: When Renzong wished to install him as crown prince, he entered to attend upon the Empress Dowager and firmly declined, saying: "Your subject is young and without ability, and has an elder brother still living; the elder brother should be installed, with your subject to assist him.
s0003.idiomatic: When Renzong wished to install him as crown prince, he entered to attend upon the Empress Dowager and firmly declined, saying, "Your subject is young and without ability, and has an elder brother still living; the elder brother should be installed, with your subject to assist him.

s0004.literal: " The Empress Dowager did not assent.
s0004.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager did not assent.

s0005.literal: On dinghai day in the twelfth month of the third year of YanYou he was installed as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure, and a princely household was opened with officials appointed.
s0005.idiomatic: On dinghai day in the twelfth month of the third year of YanYou he was installed as crown prince; he received the gold seal and treasure, and a princely household was opened with officials appointed.

s0006.literal: Surveillance censors Duan Fu, supervisor of the heir apparent's household Guo Guan, and others were first to request drawing near worthy men and selecting tutors; he welcomed and accepted this.
s0006.idiomatic: Surveillance censors Duan Fu, supervisor of the heir apparent's household Guo Guan, and others were first to request drawing near worthy men and selecting tutors; he welcomed and accepted this.

s0007.literal: In the tenth month of the sixth year, on wuwu day he received jade tablets; an edict commanded that all offices' diverse affairs must first be reported to the crown prince, and only then memorialized.
s0007.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the sixth year, on wuwu day he received jade tablets; an edict commanded that all offices' diverse affairs must first be reported to the crown prince, and only then memorialized.

s0008.literal: He said to central secretariat officials: "The Supreme One has entrusted me with the affairs of the realm; day and night I stand in reverent awe, fearing only that I may not be equal to it.
s0008.idiomatic: He said to central secretariat officials, "The Supreme One has entrusted me with the affairs of the realm; day and night I stand in reverent awe, fearing only that I may not be equal to it.

s0009.literal: You too must cleanse your hearts and wash away your thoughts, diligently perform your duties, and not cause ruin that would bring grief to lord and father."
s0009.idiomatic: You too must cleanse your hearts and wash away your thoughts, diligently perform your duties, and not cause ruin that would bring grief to lord and father."

s0010.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, on wuxu day Renzong fell ill; grief showed in his countenance; at night he burned incense and wept, saying: "The Supreme One governs the realm with benevolence; all accomplishments follow smoothly, and the four seas are tranquil.
s0010.idiomatic: Seventh year, spring, first month, on wuxu day Renzong fell ill; grief showed in his countenance; at night he burned incense and wept, saying, "The Supreme One governs the realm with benevolence; all accomplishments follow smoothly, and the four seas are tranquil.

s0011.literal: Now Heaven sends great calamity — better to punish and strike down my person, so the Supreme One may forever be lord of the people.
s0011.idiomatic: Now Heaven sends great calamity — better to punish and strike down my person, so the Supreme One may forever be lord of the people.

s0012.literal: " On xinchou day Renzong died; his grief exceeded the rites; he wore plain garments and slept upon the ground, taking one bowl of gruel each day.
s0012.idiomatic: " On xinchou day Renzong died; his grief exceeded the rites; he wore plain garments and slept upon the ground, taking one bowl of gruel each day.

s0013.literal: On guimao day the moon transgressed Dipper.
s0013.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed Dipper.

s0014.literal: On jiachen day Tiemudie'er, grand preceptor of the crown prince, was made right chancellor by the Empress Dowager's command.
s0014.idiomatic: On jiachen day Tiemudie'er, grand preceptor of the crown prince, was made right chancellor by the Empress Dowager's command.

s0015.literal: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to review criminal cases inside and outside the capital separately.
s0015.idiomatic: On bingwu day envoys were dispatched to review criminal cases inside and outside the capital separately.

s0016.literal: On wushen day the impoverished Mongols of Tong and Huo prefectures were relieved; four posts of privy council administrator were eliminated.
s0016.idiomatic: On wushen day the impoverished Mongols of Tong and Huo prefectures were relieved; 4 posts of privy council administrator were eliminated.

s0017.literal: Sorcerers, invokers, and day-selectors were forbidden to associate with imperial kin and great officials.
s0017.idiomatic: Sorcerers, invokers, and day-selectors were forbidden to associate with imperial kin and great officials.

s0018.literal: Second month, on renzi day construction of Yongfu Temple was halted.
s0018.idiomatic: Second month, on renzi day construction of Yongfu Temple was halted.

s0019.literal: Famine at the relay stations of Datong and Fengzhou was relieved.
s0019.idiomatic: Famine at the relay stations of Datong and Fengzhou was relieved.

s0020.literal: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left chancellor Heilü was made central secretariat grand councillor.
s0020.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left chancellor Heilü was made central secretariat grand councillor.

s0021.literal: On dingsi day Buddhist rites were performed.
s0021.idiomatic: On dingsi day Buddhist rites were performed.

s0022.literal: On wuwu day the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
s0022.idiomatic: On wuwu day the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.

s0023.literal: An Imperial Image Hall was built at Yongfu Temple.
s0023.idiomatic: An Imperial Image Hall was built at Yongfu Temple.

s0024.literal: Wealthy commoners who had fraudulently registered as imperial guards were eliminated and assigned corvée at the various Mongol relay stations.
s0024.idiomatic: Wealthy commoners who had fraudulently registered as imperial guards were eliminated and assigned corvée at the various Mongol relay stations.

s0025.literal: On jiwei day grain was ordered stored at the granaries of Xuande, Kaiping, Karakorum, and elsewhere, to provide for relief, loans, and provisioning.
s0025.idiomatic: On jiwei day grain was ordered stored at the granaries of Xuande, Kaiping, Karakorum, and elsewhere, to provide for relief, loans, and provisioning.

s0026.literal: The Directorate of Waterways was again placed under the central secretariat.
s0026.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterways was again placed under the central secretariat.

s0027.literal: On xinchou day the moon encroached upon Chariot Driver's Maid.
s0027.idiomatic: On xinchou day the moon encroached upon Chariot Driver's Maid.

s0028.literal: Grand councillors Chijin Temür and censor-in-chief Tuohuan were dismissed and made grand academicians of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.
s0028.idiomatic: Grand councillors Chijin Temür and censor-in-chief Tuohuan were dismissed and made grand academicians of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies.

s0029.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed Lingtai.
s0029.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed Lingtai.

s0030.literal: On jiazi day Tiemudie'er and Asan requested that Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shiyan be arrested and brought to the capital.
s0030.idiomatic: On jiazi day Tiemudie'er and Asan requested that Sichuan branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shiyan be arrested and brought to the capital.

s0031.literal: Associate deliberator on central secretariat affairs Qisiji was convicted of selling offices; the Ministry of Justice held that by law he deserved the cudgel; the Empress Dowager commanded he be flogged with the lighter bamboo; he said: "That cannot be.
s0031.idiomatic: Associate deliberator on central secretariat affairs Qisiji was convicted of selling offices; the Ministry of Justice held that by law he deserved the cudgel; the Empress Dowager commanded he be flogged with the lighter bamboo; he said, "That cannot be.

s0032.literal: Law is the public standard of the realm; to favor private feeling and lighten or aggravate punishment is not to show the realm what is public.
s0032.idiomatic: Law is the public standard of the realm; to favor private feeling and lighten or aggravate punishment is not to show the realm what is public.

s0033.literal: " In the end his guilt was corrected according to statute.
s0033.idiomatic: " In the end his guilt was corrected according to statute.

s0034.literal: On bingyin day Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shirong was made central secretariat grand councillor; Jiangxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor Mubala was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; associate administrator Zhang Siming was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat left vice chancellor Huanzhu was dismissed and made Liaobei branch secretariat right vice chancellor.
s0034.idiomatic: On bingyin day Shaanxi branch secretariat grand councillor Zhao Shirong was made central secretariat grand councillor; Jiangxi branch secretariat right vice chancellor Mubala was made central secretariat right vice chancellor; associate administrator Zhang Siming was made central secretariat left vice chancellor; central secretariat left vice chancellor Huanzhu was dismissed and made Liaobei branch secretariat right vice chancellor.

s0035.literal: On dingmao day the moon transgressed Sun-star.
s0035.idiomatic: On dingmao day the moon transgressed Sun-star.

s0036.literal: White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren was convicted of unlawful conduct; an edict registered those in Jiangnan who had falsely pretended to be White Cloud monks as commoners.
s0036.idiomatic: White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren was convicted of unlawful conduct; an edict registered those in Jiangnan who had falsely pretended to be White Cloud monks as commoners.

s0037.literal: On jisi day thunder-quelling Buddhist rites were performed at the four gates of the capital; the Ganyuan Temple transport commissioner general's office at Shangdu was abolished.
s0037.idiomatic: On jisi day thunder-quelling Buddhist rites were performed at the four gates of the capital; the Ganyuan Temple transport commissioner general's office at Shangdu was abolished.

s0038.literal: On gengwu day the moon transgressed Dipper.
s0038.idiomatic: On gengwu day the moon transgressed Dipper.

s0039.literal: On xinwei day among the people, state-affiliated mountain preserves, river fisheries, kiln smelteries, and lodgings were registered and assessed.
s0039.idiomatic: On xinwei day among the people, state-affiliated mountain preserves, river fisheries, kiln smelteries, and lodgings were registered and assessed.

s0040.literal: On renshen day Shaanxi branch surveillance censor-in-chief Dash Temür was summoned to court.
s0040.idiomatic: On renshen day Shaanxi branch surveillance censor-in-chief Dash Temür was summoned to court.

s0041.literal: Sheep, horses, cattle, and camels pastured by the government in Liaoyang, Datong, Shangdu, and Gansu were granted to households of the northern frontier; vacant land for garrison-farming was also granted.
s0041.idiomatic: Sheep, horses, cattle, and camels pastured by the government in Liaoyang, Datong, Shangdu, and Gansu were granted to households of the northern frontier; vacant land for garrison-farming was also granted.

s0042.literal: On guiyou day the lands of the Chongxiang Court were registered and assessed; where official land had been falsely presented as gift, its value was recovered; where commoners' land had been presented, it was returned to its owners.
s0042.idiomatic: On guiyou day the lands of the Chongxiang Court were registered and assessed; where official land had been falsely presented as gift, its value was recovered; where commoners' land had been presented, it was returned to its owners.

s0043.literal: Heavy criminal cases at Kaiping were decided.
s0043.idiomatic: Heavy criminal cases at Kaiping were decided.

s0044.literal: On bingzi day rotation regulations for the capital's palace guard were fixed, according to the annual precedent of the Five Guards' Han armies.
s0044.idiomatic: On bingzi day rotation regulations for the capital's palace guard were fixed, according to the annual precedent of the Five Guards' Han armies.

s0045.literal: On dingchou day former central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng's received patent as Duke of Qin State was stripped, and his ancestors' tomb stele was still overturned.
s0045.idiomatic: On dingchou day former central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng's received patent as Duke of Qin State was stripped, and his ancestors' tomb stele was still overturned.

s0046.literal: On wuyin day central secretariat grand councillor Wubadula was dismissed and made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillor; Alimuhaiya was dismissed and made Huguang branch secretariat grand councillor.
s0046.idiomatic: On wuyin day central secretariat grand councillor Wubadula was dismissed and made Gansu branch secretariat grand councillor; Alimuhaiya was dismissed and made Huguang branch secretariat grand councillor.

s0047.literal: Tiemudie'er, claiming that former investigating censor-in-chief Yang Duo'erzhi and central secretariat grand councillor Xiao Baizhu had defied the Empress Dowager's command, forged orders and killed them, and confiscated their households.
s0047.idiomatic: Tiemudie'er, claiming that former investigating censor-in-chief Yang Duo'erzhi and central secretariat grand councillor Xiao Baizhu had defied the Empress Dowager's command, forged orders and killed them, and confiscated their households.

s0048.literal: Palace Domestic Service commissioner Shiliemen, by the Empress Dowager's command, requested replacing court officials; he said: "Is this really the time for appointing and removing officials?
s0048.idiomatic: Palace Domestic Service commissioner Shiliemen, by the Empress Dowager's command, requested replacing court officials; he said, "Is this really the time for appointing and removing officials?

s0049.literal: Moreover, they are former ministers of the late emperor — how can they be lightly displaced?
s0049.idiomatic: Moreover, they are former ministers of the late emperor — how can they be lightly displaced?

s0050.literal: Wait until I take the throne; then let it be deliberated among imperial kin and senior ministers — the worthy may be appointed, the wicked may be dismissed.
s0050.idiomatic: Wait until I take the throne; then let it be deliberated among imperial kin and senior ministers — the worthy may be appointed, the wicked may be dismissed.

s0051.literal: " Minister of Agriculture Wanbuhehua said: "The land and fields that the late emperor bestowed upon various ministers should all be returned to the government.
s0051.idiomatic: " Minister of Agriculture Wanbuhehua said, "The land and fields that the late emperor bestowed upon various ministers should all be returned to the government.

s0052.literal: " He asked: "To whom were they granted?
s0052.idiomatic: " He asked, "To whom were they granted?

s0053.literal: " The reply was: "Left chancellor Asan received the most.
s0053.idiomatic: " The reply was, "Left chancellor Asan received the most.

s0054.literal: " He said: "I have often instructed you to assist with a public heart.
s0054.idiomatic: " He said, "I have often instructed you to assist with a public heart.

s0055.literal: You once requested the sea-lake tax in the former reign, and it was halted because of Asan's memorial.
s0055.idiomatic: You once requested the sea-lake tax in the former reign, and it was halted because of Asan's memorial.

s0056.literal: What you now say is again private resentment — not public deliberation; how is this the way of assisting governance?
s0056.idiomatic: What you now say is again private resentment — not public deliberation; how is this the way of assisting governance?

s0057.literal: " Wanbuhehua was thereupon transferred out as Hunan pacification commissioner.
s0057.idiomatic: " Wanbuhehua was thereupon transferred out as Hunan pacification commissioner.

s0058.literal: The received patents as minister of works and state duke of monks including Nianzhen Chilasi were stripped, and their seals cancelled.
s0058.idiomatic: The received patents as minister of works and state duke of monks including Nianzhen Chilasi were stripped, and their seals cancelled.

s0059.literal: Grande indeed was Our Taizu Emperor, who received the mandate in season and steadied the era, first opening the imperial enterprise;
s0059.idiomatic: Grande indeed was Our Taizu Emperor, who received the mandate in season and steadied the era, first opening the imperial enterprise;

s0060.literal: Shizu Emperor's divine stratagem and keen designs unified the four seas.
s0060.idiomatic: Shizu Emperor's divine stratagem and keen designs unified the four seas.

s0061.literal: Saint succeeding saint, down to Our late emperor — utmost benevolence and deep virtue nourished all living beings and ruled the myriad states; ten years are now complete.
s0061.idiomatic: Saint succeeding saint, down to Our late emperor — utmost benevolence and deep virtue nourished all living beings and ruled the myriad states; 10 years are now complete.

s0062.literal: For the distant design of the altars of state, the great foundation of the realm was settled; in concert with deliberation among imperial kin, tablets and treasure were conferred.
s0062.idiomatic: For the distant design of the altars of state, the great foundation of the realm was settled; in concert with deliberation among imperial kin, tablets and treasure were conferred.

s0063.literal: Just as the eastern palace joined in governance, suddenly Our honored father ascended as guest of Heaven.
s0063.idiomatic: Just as the eastern palace joined in governance, suddenly Our honored father ascended as guest of Heaven.

s0064.literal: Princes, noble kin, founding ministers, and great aides all said that We ought to embody the weight of the late emperor's entrustment and the Empress Dowager's protective kindness — deeply bound in the hearts of the people, how could the sacred regalia stand empty? Joint memorials urged Our advance, and sincerity met in mutual trust.
s0064.idiomatic: Princes, noble kin, founding ministers, and great aides all said that We ought to embody the weight of the late emperor's entrustment and the Empress Dowager's protective kindness — deeply bound in the hearts of the people, how could the sacred regalia stand empty? Joint memorials urged Our advance, and sincerity met in mutual trust.

s0065.literal: On the eleventh day of the third month he ascended the imperial throne at Great Brightness Hall.
s0065.idiomatic: On the eleventh day of the third month he ascended the imperial throne at Great Brightness Hall.

s0066.literal: An amnesty was proclaimed to the realm.
s0066.idiomatic: An amnesty was proclaimed to the realm.

s0067.literal: The Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
s0067.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

s0068.literal: That night the moon transgressed Mingtang.
s0068.idiomatic: That night the moon transgressed Mingtang.

s0069.literal: On renchen day the Grand Empress Dowager received the court congratulations of all officials at Xingsheng Palace.
s0069.idiomatic: On renchen day the Grand Empress Dowager received the court congratulations of all officials at Xingsheng Palace.

s0070.literal: Tiemudie'er was promoted to commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, and grand preceptor.
s0070.idiomatic: Tiemudie'er was promoted to commissioner with the same trappings as the Three Excellencies of an opened princely household, pillar of state of the upper grade, and grand preceptor.

s0071.literal: An edict commanded that among the assembled ministers, those granted nominal offices beyond their rank were not to exceed their proper order at court assemblies.
s0071.idiomatic: An edict commanded that among the assembled ministers, those granted nominal offices beyond their rank were not to exceed their proper order at court assemblies.

s0072.literal: Princes Yesun Temür, Tuota Noyan, and others were granted gold, silver, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.
s0072.idiomatic: Princes Yesun Temür, Tuota Noyan, and others were granted gold, silver, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.

s0073.literal: Famine among troops and commoners of Ningxia Route was relieved.
s0073.idiomatic: Famine among troops and commoners of Ningxia Route was relieved.

s0074.literal: On jiawu day Buddhist rites were performed at the Hall of Precious Kindness; famine at eleven relay stations including Mulin and Hundu'er was relieved.
s0074.idiomatic: On jiawu day Buddhist rites were performed at the Hall of Precious Kindness; famine at 11 relay stations including Mulin and Hundu'er was relieved.

s0075.literal: On yiwei day the sun showed a bright halo like linked rings.
s0075.idiomatic: On yiwei day the sun showed a bright halo like linked rings.

s0076.literal: On bingshen day the Olros and others submitted inward; fourteen thousand ingots of notes were granted, and they were sent back to their departments.
s0076.idiomatic: On bingshen day the Olros and others submitted inward; 14,000 ingots of notes were granted, and they were sent back to their departments.

s0077.literal: Privy council administrator Yeljini was dispatched to inspect garrison-farms and guards at Gongchang and other routes, and select garrison soldiers from Ganzhou.
s0077.idiomatic: Privy council administrator Yeljini was dispatched to inspect garrison-farms and guards at Gongchang and other routes, and select garrison soldiers from Ganzhou.

s0078.literal: On wuxu day five posts of Shangdu resident commissioner were eliminated; clerk-origin officials' rank was fixed at no higher than secondary seventh grade, as in the former system.
s0078.idiomatic: On wuxu day 5 posts of Shangdu resident commissioner were eliminated; clerk-origin officials' rank was fixed at no higher than secondary seventh grade, as in the former system.

s0079.literal: On gengzi day the Grand Ceremonies Bureau, Communications Court, Protectorate General, and Office of August Blessings were all reduced to secondary second grade;
s0079.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Grand Ceremonies Bureau, Communications Court, Protectorate General, and Office of August Blessings were all reduced to secondary second grade;

s0080.literal: the Mongol Directorate of Education, Directorate of Waterways, Palace Stud, and Palace Provisioner were all reduced to secondary third grade;
s0080.idiomatic: the Mongol Directorate of Education, Directorate of Waterways, Palace Stud, and Palace Provisioner were all reduced to secondary third grade;

s0081.literal: Supervising Secretaries, Missing-Persons Inspectorate, Palace Quarters Bureau, and Directorate of Astronomy were all reduced to primary fourth grade;
s0081.idiomatic: Supervising Secretaries, Missing-Persons Inspectorate, Palace Quarters Bureau, and Directorate of Astronomy were all reduced to primary fourth grade;

s0082.literal: their officials were reduced one grade in descending sequence with differences; those of seventh grade and below were not reduced.
s0082.idiomatic: their officials were reduced one grade in descending sequence with differences; those of seventh grade and below were not reduced.

s0083.literal: Princes, imperial sons-in-law, and commanders and soldiers on frontier garrison duty were granted gold, silver, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.
s0083.idiomatic: Princes, imperial sons-in-law, and commanders and soldiers on frontier garrison duty were granted gold, silver, and silks and cloths in varying amounts.

s0084.literal: Five hundred thousand sheep and one hundred thousand horses were purchased to supply the impoverished of the northern frontier.
s0084.idiomatic: 500,000 sheep and 100,000 horses were purchased to supply the impoverished of the northern frontier.

s0085.literal: On xinchou day unauthorized memorials bearing imperial seals were forbidden.
s0085.idiomatic: On xinchou day unauthorized memorials bearing imperial seals were forbidden.

s0086.literal: The Privy Council was additionally placed in charge of the left and right guard rate offices.
s0086.idiomatic: The Privy Council was additionally placed in charge of the left and right guard rate offices.

s0087.literal: On renyin day former central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng was reduced to Academician Lecturer of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies; all patents previously received were stripped.
s0087.idiomatic: On renyin day former central secretariat grand councillor Li Meng was reduced to Academician Lecturer of the Academy of Scholarly Worthies; all patents previously received were stripped.

s0088.literal: Censorate officials requested an edict instructing all offices to strengthen censorate discipline; the Emperor said: "You need only keep your duties and speak fully; if what you say is good, We shall follow it; if not, We shall still not punish you.
s0088.idiomatic: Censorate officials requested an edict instructing all offices to strengthen censorate discipline; the Emperor said, "You need only keep your duties and speak fully; if what you say is good, We shall follow it; if not, We shall still not punish you.

s0089.literal: " On jiachen day an edict commanded that inside and outside the court must not obstruct discussion of Tiemudie'er.
s0089.idiomatic: " On jiachen day an edict commanded that inside and outside the court must not obstruct discussion of Tiemudie'er.

s0090.literal: An edict halted the hereditary appointment of physicians', diviners', and craftsmen's sons; those whose skill was surpassing were to be selected for employment.
s0090.idiomatic: An edict halted the hereditary appointment of physicians', diviners', and craftsmen's sons; those whose skill was surpassing were to be selected for employment.

s0091.literal: On bingwu day the southern suburb was sacrificed to; accession was announced.
s0091.idiomatic: On bingwu day the southern suburb was sacrificed to; accession was announced.

s0092.literal: On dingwei day the Chongxiang Court was abolished; the Directorate-General for Artisans and Craftsmen was placed under the Directorate for Palace Construction.
s0092.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Chongxiang Court was abolished; the Directorate-General for Artisans and Craftsmen was placed under the Directorate for Palace Construction.

s0093.literal: Summer, fourth month, on gengxu day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was sacrificed to; accession was announced.
s0093.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, on gengxu day the Imperial Ancestral Temple was sacrificed to; accession was announced.

s0094.literal: The post of minister of works held by Fosu was posthumously stripped.
s0094.idiomatic: The post of minister of works held by Fosu was posthumously stripped.

s0095.literal: The Directorate of Palace Treasures was abolished; the ranks of the Offices of Ceremonial Phoenix, Music Bureau, and Broad Benevolence were restored.
s0095.idiomatic: The Directorate of Palace Treasures was abolished; the ranks of the Offices of Ceremonial Phoenix, Music Bureau, and Broad Benevolence were restored.

s0096.literal: Branch secretariat chancellors were abolished; Henan branch secretariat chancellor Yesi Temür, Huguang branch secretariat chancellor Duorzhijin, and Liaoyang branch secretariat chancellor were all reduced to grand councillors of their respective provinces; only the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat chancellor, the king of Koryo, was not reduced.
s0096.idiomatic: Branch secretariat chancellors were abolished; Henan branch secretariat chancellor Yesi Temür, Huguang branch secretariat chancellor Duorzhijin, and Liaoyang branch secretariat chancellor were all reduced to grand councillors of their respective provinces; only the Eastern Campaign branch secretariat chancellor, the king of Koryo, was not reduced.

s0097.literal: Prince Temür Buqa was granted fifteen thousand ingots of notes.
s0097.idiomatic: Prince Temür Buqa was granted 15,000 ingots of notes.

s0098.literal: On jiayin day Venus transgressed Saturn.
s0098.idiomatic: On jiayin day Venus transgressed Saturn.

s0099.literal: On yimao day the Directorate of Education and Directorate of Waterways were restored, with rank primary third grade.
s0099.idiomatic: On yimao day the Directorate of Education and Directorate of Waterways were restored, with rank primary third grade.

s0100.literal: The Muslim Directorate of Education and itinerant Communications Court were abolished.
s0100.idiomatic: The Muslim Directorate of Education and itinerant Communications Court were abolished.
